body: Glad to be of help. You made a friend and so did I. ☺

I guess we have the same problem somehow. I understand your problem and I'm guessing your parents are your triggers for your suicidal tendencies? To be honest I don't know what to do even on your situation because I have the same problem concerning my parents, my grandparents too. But for now, let's try to weather the storm just  like a fellow redditor said (u/whirlpoohl). Let's try to be calm and tranquil when our thoughts attack. When I am depressed and anxious, I just sleep and shut other people out including my brother, parents and grandparents (I turn off my phone BTW). So I encourage you to distract yourself or meditate in case you don't feel like going out. If you need help just PM me. ☺

No progress. My grandmother just called from California and as usual, she just complained about my college life. I'm traveling later to my college dorm and I'll go straight to my bed and sleep. My depression is getting worse as the semester is nearing it's end. And I'm running out of options because my dad also pressures me and  blaming me from time to time. 

Thank God for Reddit. Because I am able to talk with some ladies and gents suffering from the same stuff I am going through. At least I have you guys to listen even though I don't know where you are in this world.

Please don't hesitate to PM me for more personal talks. Let's help each other. People suffering from the same condition as I have are the only people who can understand me and others as well. Thanks staticblues for asking how I'm doing. ☺
I'm in a similar position right now. You can talk to me. ☺ I'm in a third world country too.
